title: How to Build an Emergency Fund on a Low Income (Step by Step)
description:
Want to build an emergency fund but living on a low income? You can start with just $10 a week, and this video shows you exactly how.

We walk through a simple, step-by-step plan: start with a $500 starter fund, find hidden money in fees and forgotten subscriptions, save a fixed amount every week, automate it on payday, keep it in a separate federally insured savings account, boost it with extra cash, and know what really counts as an emergency. Then we map out the path from $500 to 3 to 6 months of essential expenses.
